request.style: English, jazz, warm female solo voice, double bass, upright piano, brushed snare, muted trumpet, soft brushed rhythm, gentle and reflective mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Children obey in the Lord today
For this way is right and true
Heaven's law is clear to show
What the heart must always do

[Pre-Chorus]
Listen now to the command
First of all with a promise
That you might live long on earth
And find your life in blessing

[Chorus]
Honor your father and mother
This is the first commandment
With a promise for your days
So that it may go well

[Verse]
Walk in the path that is set
Obey the voice of the Lord
This is right before your eyes
Keep the covenant word

[Chorus]
Honor your father and mother
This is the first commandment
With a promise for your days
So that it may go well

[Bridge]
Live long on the earth
Go well in your days
Honor the command
Keep the sacred ways

[Chorus]
Honor your father and mother
This is the first commandment
With a promise for your days
So that it may go well

[Outro]
Honor your father and mother
Live long in the land
